title: iGCSE Computer Science Paper 2 vocabulary
notes: Includes every term in the previous straight list, plus the Python reference names supplied earlier.
Descriptions and sample questions are original teaching material. Student answers are illustrative, not official mark-scheme wording.
The 13 exam_command entries follow the supplied 2029 syllabus command-word list. Other practical instructions are labelled exam_instruction.
Examples use Python 3.10 or later. Python code, printed output and example input are separate fields.
File examples create small example files in the current working directory. Run them in a practice folder.
Terms from the old book and supporting vocabulary are not all separately named syllabus requirements.

entries.description: The file-mode string for appending; writes go to the end and the file is created if absent.

python_example.code:
with open("note.txt", "w") as file:
    file.write("A")
with open("note.txt", "a") as file:
    file.write("B")
with open("note.txt", "r") as file:
    print(file.read())

entries.description: The file-mode string for reading an existing file; a missing file normally raises FileNotFoundError.
